pageTitle: Klacks | Workforce scheduling that belongs to you
hero.badge: Open Source · On-Premise · Swiss Data Protection
hero.titleHtml: Workforce scheduling that keeps you in control.
hero.subtitle: Klacks schedules shifts automatically, optimizes routes, and can be run by voice through an AI assistant — on-premise, open source, with the AI model of your choice. For home care, hospitals, security, cleaning, and logistics organizations.
hero.trust2: AI with free choice of model
hero.screenshotAlt: Klacks schedule grid with shifts, groups, and staff
hero.screenshotCaption: Screenshot shown in German — the app itself is also available in English.
painPoints.item1.title: Scheduling eats up hours
painPoints.item1.text: Building schedules by hand costs hours every week. One change triggers a dozen follow-on conflicts.
painPoints.item2.title: Compliance risk
painPoints.item2.text: Rest periods, qualifications, pay premiums, public holidays. One overlooked value quickly becomes a costly mistake.
painPoints.item3.title: Forced cloud & lock-in
painPoints.item3.text: Personal data on someone else's servers, dependence on a single vendor. Sensitive industries can't afford that.
usp.title: You stay in control.
usp.subtitle: Over your data, over the AI behind it, and over your rules. Three reasons why Klacks is different from any cloud solution.
usp.data.label: Your data
usp.data.title: On-Premise & Open Source
usp.data.text: Klacks runs on your own infrastructure — not a single record leaves the building. 100% open source, no vendor lock-in. Your data belongs to you, today and in ten years.
usp.ai.label: Your AI
usp.ai.titleHtml: Klacksy — with your choice of model
usp.ai.text: An AI assistant you control by voice. You choose the LLM yourself — from OpenAI, Anthropic & co. to a local model. No forced choice, no lock-in with an AI provider.
usp.rules.label: Your rules
usp.rules.title: Pre-configured & fully customizable
usp.rules.text: Rules, calculations, and public holidays come pre-configured for your country, canton, and municipality. You can adjust everything yourself — no consulting days, no waiting for the next release.
aiSynergy.eyebrow: The combination almost no one offers
aiSynergy.titleHtml: AI and full data sovereignty. At the same time.
aiSynergy.textHtml: Klacksy can run on a local language model. That means an assistant that builds schedules, creates staff records, and operates the app by voice — without a single personnel or patient record ever leaving your building. Exactly what hospitals, home care, and security services need.
klacksy.title: Your AI assistant for scheduling
klacksy.item1.title: Control in natural language
klacksy.item1.text: “Fill next week's early shifts” is enough — typed or spoken.
klacksy.item2.title: Free choice of language model
klacksy.item2.text: OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Gemini — or a local model. You decide on cost, privacy, and provider.
klacksy.item3.title: 170+ skills
klacksy.item3.text: Create staff, manage groups, set permissions, navigate — all through conversation.
klacksy.item4.title: Gateway for external AI agents
klacksy.item4.text: A Model Context Protocol server lets you connect Klacks to other AI tools.
klacksy.imageAlt: Klacksy AI assistant panel in Klacks – with model selection and natural-language control
autoPlanning.title: Let the machine build the schedule
autoPlanning.subtitle: An evolutionary algorithm checks thousands of variants in seconds and finds the best balance of coverage, cost, and satisfaction.
autoPlanning.item1.title: One-click auto-scheduling
autoPlanning.item1.text: The tedious part — done in seconds. The algorithm respects every constraint: labor law, qualifications, availability, and travel distances.
autoPlanning.item2.title: Route & Tour Optimization
autoPlanning.item2.text: For mobile operations: routes optimized with an ant colony algorithm — by car, bike, on foot, or mixed. Ideal for home care, security patrols, cleaning, and logistics.
autoPlanning.item3.title: Modular scheduling without double-booking
autoPlanning.item3.text: Share staff across departments without conflicts: schedule sheets hold references instead of copies. A change is instantly visible everywhere — double-booking becomes impossible.
autoPlanning.item4.title: Absences at a glance
autoPlanning.item4.text: Vacation, sick leave, and custom absence types at a glance as a Gantt chart. Export to PDF with a single click.
autoPlanning.item5.title: Approval workflow
autoPlanning.item5.text: From draft through confirmed and approved to completed. Each stage locks further editing — with group-based access rights.
autoPlanning.item6.title: Interactive schedule grid
autoPlanning.item6.text: A powerful time matrix: move shifts by drag & drop, and changes appear in real time for everyone involved.
divideConquer.title: Large schedules stay manageable
divideConquer.subtitle: Instead of juggling one unwieldy master schedule, break it into small, clear sub-schedules — and Klacks automatically keeps everything in sync.
divideConquer.step1.label: Step 1
divideConquer.step1.title: Split it up
divideConquer.step1.text: Break the large schedule into manageable areas — by team, department, or location.
divideConquer.step2.label: Step 2
divideConquer.step2.title: Schedule once
divideConquer.step2.text: Anyone working across multiple areas is scheduled only once — and appears correctly everywhere, automatically.
divideConquer.step3.label: Step 3
divideConquer.step3.title: Automatically in sync
divideConquer.step3.text: A single change is instantly current everywhere. Double-booking is ruled out — with no manual upkeep at all.
rulesCalendar.title: A calendar for every reality
rulesCalendar.text: Public holidays and rules are a patchwork in Switzerland — they vary by canton, and sometimes even by municipality. Klacks masters exactly what simple tools fail at.
rulesCalendar.item1.title: Down to municipality level
rulesCalendar.item1.text: Country, region (canton, state, département), and municipality — pre-configured to fit.
rulesCalendar.item2.title: Mix calendars
rulesCalendar.item2.text: Multiple countries at once — for example Geneva and the US, for a business with trading partners there.
rulesCalendar.item3.title: Enforced or just informational
rulesCalendar.item3.text: You decide per calendar whether a public holiday affects hours & pay premiums — or just appears as a reminder.
rulesCalendar.imageAlt: Public holiday rules in Klacks: holidays by nation and region – Germany, the US (Alaska), and the Swiss cantons of Lucerne, Jura, Glarus, and Appenzell
rulesCalendar.imageCaption: Real rules from Klacks: one list mixes public holidays from several countries and individual cantons — freely extendable.
industries.title: Built for shift- and field-based operations
industries.subtitle: Wherever staff are scheduled in shifts, in the field, and by qualification — Klacks adapts to you, not the other way around.
industries.spitex.title: Home Care
industries.spitex.text: Routes, qualifications, and care pay premiums — scheduled automatically.
industries.spitaeler.title: Hospitals
industries.spitaeler.text: 24/7 coverage, rest periods, and hospital-grade data protection.
industries.security.title: Security
industries.security.text: Sites, patrols, and certifications reliably covered.
industries.hausdienste.title: Cleaning Services
industries.hausdienste.text: Site routes and rotating teams scheduled efficiently.
industries.logistik.title: Logistics
industries.logistik.text: Routes, driving times, and cross-border operations under control.
languages.title: Multilingual from the ground up
languages.text: Four core languages out of the box — German, French, Italian, and English. Additional languages can be added as plugins, complete with geodata, calendar rules, and terminology for the AI assistant.
getStarted.title: Try it. Download it. Get going.
getStarted.subtitle: No demo appointments, no sales calls: try Klacks right in your browser — or install it on your own server in a matter of minutes.
getStarted.playground.title: Try it in the Playground
getStarted.playground.text: A public Klacks instance with sample data — right in your browser, no installation, no registration.
getStarted.download.title: Install it on your own server
getStarted.download.text: The On-Premise package includes everything: Docker images, installer, database, HTTPS, and automatic updates. One command — and Klacks is up and running.
getStarted.source.title: Source code on GitHub
getStarted.source.text: Klacks is open source under the MIT license. Backend, frontend, and Docker images are public — inspect it, fork it, contribute.
getStarted.community.title: Questions? Ideas? Conversation?
getStarted.community.text: The Klacks community meets on Discord — ask questions, share your experiences, and be the first to hear about new releases.
